mcqs.question: In the April 2025 drought declaration in Andhra Pradesh, how many severe and moderate drought mandals were reported in Anantapur district, respectively?
mcqs.explanation: Anantapur had 6 severe and 1 moderate drought mandal. The combination of 9 severe and 1 moderate belonged to Kurnool and YSR Kadapa, while 11 severe and 6 moderate belonged to Prakasam.

mcqs.question: In the April 2025 drought declaration in Andhra Pradesh, what was the classification of drought mandals in Sri Sathya Sai district?
mcqs.explanation: Sri Sathya Sai district had 1 severe and 1 moderate drought mandal. The combination of 6 severe and 1 moderate belonged to Anantapur, whereas 9 severe and 1 moderate was reported for Kurnool and YSR Kadapa.
